📄Publications

2026

If You Hear It, Help Find It: Orthogonal Knowledge Distillation for Open-Vocabulary Audio-Visual Event Localization

Cheng Chen*, Yi Xu*, Wenzhuo Lei (* equal contribution)

ACM Multimedia (ACM MM) 2026

We study open-vocabulary audio-visual event localization when visual and audio teachers differ in reliability. OV-OrthKD places their supervision in separate orthogonal feature paths and uses text prototypes for open-vocabulary transfer.

OrthKD: Extracting Generalized Clinical Knowledge from Heterogeneous Teachers for Lightweight Deployment

Yi Xu*, Cheng Chen*, Mufan Cao (* equal contribution)

International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence (IJCAI) 2026

We study multi-teacher distillation for diabetic retinopathy screening. OrthKD transfers complementary feature-level knowledge from heterogeneous teachers to a 5.4M-parameter MobileNetV3 student.

Enabling Visual Reasoning in Text-Only LLMs via Symbolic Scene Descriptions

Wenzhuo Lei, Mufan Cao, Chaorong Ye, Yi Xu, Cheng Chen

International Joint Conference on Neural Networks (IJCNN) 2026 Corresponding Author

We convert images into grammar-constrained scene descriptions that can be processed by a text-only LLM. On VQAv2, DeepYOLO achieves 42.3% accuracy while using 2.5× fewer prompt tokens than scene-graph serialization.
